repo_standards_ref: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, references/global-crew.md (match surrounding conventions; module is explicit sibling of compute_regime_deficits)

smells.finding: Longest function class_deficits (~40 LOC) is linear and sectioned with comments; each helper (build_weight_matrix, _segment_transit_times, _validate_profile) is single-purpose and short.
Only two dataclasses, both pure frozen data holders (ClassTimeLedger, ClassDeficits); no behavior-bearing god class.
_segment_transit_times is factored once and reused for ideal + real laps; no copy-paste.
Reads SegmentMap fields (seg_type_code, severity_membership, segment_of, n_segments) but that is the map's intended read-only consumption surface, not envy of another object's internals.
The trio (segment_map, distance_m, speed/v_ideal/v_real) recurs across class_time_ledger, class_time_shares, class_deficits.

override.repo_standard: global-crew.md 'Match the surrounding code's naming/conventions'; module docstring declares it a class-grain SIBLING of driver_utility_observable.compute_regime_deficits, whose per-lap signature is (segment_map/ribbon, distance, speeds).
override.reason: Bundling these into a LapProfile object would diverge the pure-function surface from the established sibling convention and add an abstraction the handoff did not ask for (no speculative abstraction). The clump is the deliberate, matching public contract, not accidental.

smells.finding: Uses np.ndarray for numeric channels and a small {class_id: float} dict for the convenience view; appropriate for a numeric core, not stringly-typed primitives standing in for domain types.
Max 4 positional (segment_map, distance_m, v_ideal, v_real) + 1 keyword-only min_speed_ms with an inherited default; within reasonable bounds.
New self-contained module; no cross-cutting edit scatter introduced.
Single cohesive responsibility (class-grain time ledger + absolute deficits); no unrelated axes bolted together.
No a.b().c().d() chains; SegmentMap accessors called directly.

dominant_class_of is a REQUIRED diagnostic named by decision:class-attribution-membership-faithful (argmax allowed only as derived view), not speculative; class_time_shares is a thin, used convenience. No unused hooks or extension points.
Comments are contract-bearing (anti-circularity rationale, construction-vs-validation labeling, simulator-mirror citations), explaining WHY not masking unclear code.
